title: Edgeware & Kabocha: Project Overview [2020 - July 2022]
body:
# Edgeware and Kabocha Project Overview 
 

Below is a six page report of Edgeware and Kabocha's **83** project requests, 
September 2020 -  July 2022.


**58 **- Services
**17** - Features
**4** -   Expansion 
**4** -   Integration 

![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/35568799-2a87-41c2-b3c5-2f29ae6f2027.1657729580141)


**Project Status**

1. **Pending:** _Open Dependencies _
2. **In Progress:**  _In Development _
3. **Complete:** _Agreement Fulfilled _
4. **Unfulfilled:** _Outstanding Milestones or Deliverables _
5. **Closed:**  _Funds Returned to Treasury _


**Actionable Stages**


1. **Research: **_Scoping for Milestones and Deliverables_
2. **Implementation:** _Last Update less than 30 days_
3. **Community Update**: _Last Update greater than 60 days_
4. **Outstanding: **_Project Length > 365 days_



1. **Dynamic Service: **_New or Upgrade to an existing Citizen based Service _
2. **Dynamic Feature: **_New or Upgrade to an existing Citizen based Product_
3. **Dynamic Service Provider: **_New Contributor Support_ 
4. **Community Review:** _Subject to Moratorium_


**Improvement type for our** **DAO** 

1. Marketing/Engagement 
2. Community Building 
3. Technical Upgrade


**Benefit type for our Citizens **

1. Expansion 
2. Integration
3. Feature
4. Service
